items.title: Email Campaign · : Concierge "Year 1.5 Math" Campaign
items.preview:
**Audience:** Concierge upsell candidates (13-24 months post-install, not on Concierge). 100 members. All past their year-1 service, so Rule 1 is satisfied.
**Subject line (primary):**
`The question we get at month 18`
**Alternates:**
- (curiosity) `Is Concierge actually worth it for you?`
- (pain) `Who's swapping your RO filters this year?`
- (authority) `Here's the honest math on Concierge`
- (specific) `$99/mo: what it covers, what it doesn't`
**Preview text:**
`No pressure. Just the numbers, so you can decide for yourself.`
**Body:**
Hi Albert,
Around the 18-month mark, we get one question a lot: "Is this Concierge thing actually worth it for me?"
Fair question. Here is the honest math.
Concierge is $99/mo. It covers your annual service, filter swaps, priority phone support, and parts coverage on the standard install components of your Re-Ionator Pro system. If you are currently handling service pay-as-you-go, add up a year of filter swaps plus a service visit and compare. For some folks it pays for itself. For others it does not, and we will tell you that.
If you want, reply here and I will run your specific numbers. No pressure either way.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
**Send timing:** Tuesday, 10 AM ET.
**Expected performance:**
- Open: 30-38%. Your list average is 42%, but the recent "Access Your Client App" sends cratered to 0.2-0.7% (likely deliverability/subject fatigue). A plain, non-salesy subject to a warm, small segment should recover most of the historic average.
- Click/reply: 2-4%. This asks for a reply, not a click, which suits a warm segment.
- Conversion to Concierge: 3-6 sign-ups realistic from 100 warm, trust-established clients.
**Source justification:** CONCIERGE UPSELL CONTEXT (the "$99/mo," the "is this worth it for me? Here's the math" framing, and the 13-24 month filtered list). Respects HARD RULE 1 and 2 (named the actual product).

items.title: Email Campaign · : Referral Push. 30-60 Day Post-Install
items.preview:
**Audience:** Referral push candidates (satisfied, 30-60 days post-install). 29 members. Newly installed, high satisfaction, best window for referrals.
**Subject line (primary):**
`Know someone with bad water? Read this.`
**Alternates:**
- (curiosity) `You've had your system a month. One ask.`
- (specific) `$500 when your referral installs`
- (authority) `The referrals we actually want`
- (pain) `Your neighbor's water is probably worse than yours was`
**Preview text:**
`A quick thank-you and one thing that helps us more than a review ever could.`
**Body:**
Hi Janine,
You have had your ClearWave Sovereign running for about a month now. Hopefully the water speaks for itself.
One ask. If a friend, neighbor, or family member has been complaining about their water, send them our way. If they book, they get a free water assessment. If they close, you get $500 cash. That climbs to $750 for your 6th through 9th referral in a year, and $1,000 once you hit 10.
Even if they just take the consult and do not move forward, we send you a $50 gift card for the introduction.
Just reply with a name and the best way to reach them, and we will handle the rest.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
**Send timing:** Thursday, 11 AM ET.
**Expected performance:**
- Open: 38-45%. This is your freshest, warmest segment (installed weeks ago), likely to exceed list average.
- Click/reply: 4-6%. Direct reply-with-a-name ask outperforms link clicks for this group.
- Conversion: 1-3 referral introductions realistic from 29; even 1 closed referral returns $500 for roughly zero acquisition cost.
**Source justification:** REFERRAL BONUS STRUCTURE (exact $500/$750/$1,000 tiers and $50 gift card), HARD RULE 3 (referrals, not reviews) and 3a (exact "free water assessment" phrase), and HARD RULE 2 (named "ClearWave Sovereign").
---
**Why these two:** The Concierge segment (100) and referral segment (29) are the highest-intent, lowest-cost conversions available this week, and both dodge the deliverability collapse hurting your broadcast sends. I'd hold the 1,000 cold-lead re-engagement for a dedicated week. It needs a warm-up plan given your recent sub-1% opens, or it'll hurt domain reputation further.
